info.name: VaxAccess Phase I API
info.description:
Design of the **future** VaxAccess domain API: six read-only endpoints for vaccination Sites, Vaccine categories and Volunteer opportunities in Austin and Travis County.

**Status: design only.** Phase I of VaxAccess (https://vaxaccess.me) is a static site that bundles its records as JSON; none of these six endpoints is deployed, and there is no mock server. The saved examples, generated from the Phase I fixtures, are the Phase I demonstration. The test scripts are written for a future server and have not been run against one.

Records are historical examples of community vaccination work, not a current appointment directory. For current services, see Austin Public Health: https://www.austintexas.gov/health/programs/immunizations

### Conventions
- List responses: `{ data, meta, included }`. `meta` = page, pageSize, totalItems, filteredItems, totalPages.
- Detail responses: `{ data, relationships, included }`.
- `included.sources` and `included.media` contain the source and media objects referenced by the returned records.
- Errors: `{ error: { code, message, details? } }` with 400 (invalid query), 404 (unknown ID) or 500.
- Filtering and sorting use the same display strings and rules as the website's listing pages.

Repository: https://gitlab.com/nifemisoyemi/cs373-fall-2026-18

request.description:
Paginated Site collection.

Filters (`filter[fieldKey]`) combine with AND and match the same display strings the website shows on cards: `address`, `populationServed`, `costPolicy`, `appointmentMethod`, `vaccines`. Ties in sorting fall back to name A–Z, then ID.

`meta.totalPages` is calculated from `filteredItems`; an empty filtered result has `totalPages` 0. A valid page beyond the results returns 200 with empty `data`. Unknown filters or sort fields, duplicate scalar parameters and invalid pagination values return 400.

query.description: Integer ≥ 1. Default 1.
Integer 1–100. Default 3.

asc or desc. Default asc.
